lastCompletedStory.title: Enable noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters in tsconfig.json

nextStoryContext: US-004 was the last story of this PRD (CAM-135). tsconfig.json noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters are now true, noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature stays false (out of scope). Pre-flip sanity re-run of `bunx tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters` was clean (exit 0, no output) immediately before the flip, confirming US-001/002/003's cleanup held. Post-flip: bun run typecheck ok, bun test 4529 pass / 0 fail, bun run check:all all 12 gates green (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code/knip, dup/jscpd, ci-parity, agents-md). knip.json and biome.json untouched (git diff --exit-code clean) per scope -- no biome noUnusedVariables was added, tsc is the enforcement mechanism because biome.json excludes test/** and would have missed most violations. No new gate was added; typecheck rides existing gate #1. All userStories in prd.json now have passes reaching true after supervisor processes this story's worker-report -- this PRD (CAM-135) should be at or near completion.
